ns2:section.sectionText: 4 credit hours Students in online section AN1 must also register for one of the three AD discussion sections. Video lectures, course materials, and a discussion board will be made available online through CITES Wiki. Optional face-to-face Supplementary Instruction sessions will also be available to all students. Students are expected to complete online assignments and examinations on ACE Organic as outlined in the course syllabus. This section has one or more proctored online exams which may carry additional fees.
